content: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.

source: Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance

content: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.

source: The Tibetan Book of Living and Dying

content: My heart is at ease knowing that what was meant for me will never miss me, and that what misses me was never meant for me.
Wherever you go, go with all your heart.

A man's true wealth is the good he does in this world.
There is a voice that doesn't use words. Listen.
You must be the change you wish to see in the world.
The measure of who we are is what we do with what we have.
